thread:
elaine: Heads-up 1: proposing a 'gatekeeper' rollout flow for regional model switches. Goal: fewer manual hops but still safe for customers. Key pieces: safety tier (low/med/high), composite health check, tenant opt-ins, and an operator "single-click" emergency stop. Proposing slices: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Bake windows: 10m, 20m, 45m, 90m. Thoughts?
sam: Love the safety tiers. Req: define what makes a rollout "low" vs "high" risk (model size, training delta, customer impact). Also we should surface an explicit 'A/B holdout' for experiments so we can compare quality.
michael: From SRE - composite health should reduce noise. I suggest a conservative composite: (user-error-rate > 3x baseline OR p95 latency > 40% uplift) AND (synthetic-quality-fail OR traffic-drop > 5%). Only escalate if conditions persist for 4 minutes.
rita: Ops asks: Console needs a clear timeline UI and the single-click stop must create an audit event + optional rollback snapshot. Also we need a per-tenant override flow for customers who opt into early access. Sales will need an approval ticket flow if they request faster ramps.
elaine: Good inputs. For safety-tier mapping idea: low = minor param updates/quant-ops with <0.5% eval delta; medium = architecture changes/quantization that increase eff cost; high = retrains or model family change. Low tiers get semi-auto advance; medium require operator ack on >10% steps; high always manual-ack.
sam: API suggestion for rollout creation: 
```
ri rollout create --name gatekeeper-1822223333 \
  --model=redwood-emu-l2 \
  --regions=us-east-1,eu-west-1 \
  --slices=0.5,2,10,50,100 \
  --bakes=10m,20m,45m,90m \
  --safety-tier=medium \
  --holdout=10% \
  --operator-ack=true
```
Also add flags: allow_tenant_optins, sales_accel_workflow_id.
michael: Auto-rollback semantics: if composite fails for 4m -> rollback-to-fallback and create incident stub with trace. Add a cooldown of 45m before the same model can be tried again in that region. Keep notifications to oncall + owners list.
rita: For auditability: every advance/rollback must record (actor, reason, metrics snapshot, canary-id). The Console should render the last three snapshots inline. And the stop button should allow 'pause' vs 'rollback' options.
elaine: Regarding A/B holdouts: we can reserve a per-route cohort that never sees the new model for X days to compute longitudinal quality. That's helpful for subtle regressions.
sam: Backend note: KV cache TTL during rollouts will be tricky. Propose a cache-invalidation token attached to rollout id that services can honor to avoid cross-slice contamination.
michael: Chaos windows: do not advance during active infra incidents or during maintenance blocks for the target region. Hook into status-service.
rita: Customer-facing SLA for sales-accelerated ramps: require legal signoff + security review; level 1 approval SLA 24h. We'll attach a checklist in the approval ticket template.
elaine: OK action items: Rita -> console stop/pause UI + audit schema. ETA 72h. owner=rita
sam: Backend -> rollout API + cache-token prototype. ETA 2w. owner=sam
michael: SRE -> composite-check implementation + cooldown enforcement. ETA 10 days. owner=michael
rita: Biz ops -> sales accel flow + approval template. ETA 3d. owner=rita
elaine: We'll pilot internal gatekeeper rollout next Wednesday to eu-west-1 with safety-tier low and semi-auto advance. Post any objections here. ops-bot: rollout:initiated id=gatekeeper-1822223333 region=eu-west-1 slice=0.5
elain e: minor typo fixed? (it should be 'elaine')
sam: :thumbsup: good to go
